set system host-name CE3.explanation: Configure the host name of the device.

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: The host name of the equipment is used to identify the equipment in the network.

parameters.name: bridge-domain
parameters.explanation: Bridge domain names, such as vlan10.

domain-type bridge.explanation: Configure the type of bridge area.

parameters.name: domain-type
parameters.explanation: Type of bridge domain, for example, Bridge.

interface ae10.100.explanation: Adds the interface to the bridge field.

unit 0 family ethernet-switching port-mo.explanation: Configure the Ethernet exchange and port modes of the interface.

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: Interface unit number to distinguish between multiple logical configurations under the same interface.

unit 100 encapsulation vlan-bridge.explanation: Configure the containment type of the interface.

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: Interface unit number to distinguish between multiple logical configurations under the same interface.

unit 100 vlan-id 100.explanation: Configure the VLAN ID of the interface.

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: Interface unit number to distinguish between multiple logical configurations under the same interface.

parameters.name: vlan-id
parameters.explanation: VLAN ID, used to identify VLAN.

ether-options 802.3ad ae10.explanation: Configure Ethernet options for interfaces, e.g., joining a chain aggregation group.

parameters.name: aggregated-interface
parameters.explanation: The name of the polymer interface, e.g. ae10.

delete interfaces ge-0/0/0.explanation: The command fragment `delete interfaces [parameter1]` removes the configuration for the specified interface (`[parameter1]`) from the Junos device.

disable.explanation: Deletes the disablement status of the interface.
